notes.title: Body Fluids
notes.notes:
Our latest version now includes some "body fluid action" with fluid simulation. 

Hold your right trigger button to start painting the sisters white and watch it flow all over them.  Some extra features added to the menu system allows you to set the amount of fluid and the size of your tool. You also have the option to let the liquid fade and the models will over time lose your liquid as it evaporates.
